about: Shawinigan is in Mauricie, on the rivière Saint-Maurice north of Trois-Rivières. It grew as a hydroelectric and aluminum city at a set of falls and remains a regional centre for the middle Saint-Maurice valley. The amalgamated city includes Shawinigan-Sud and riverside neighbourhoods facing the gorge. About 50,000 people live in Shawinigan.
